name: István Kovács
bio:
István’s journey into the world of motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with Lada engines in his father's garage. His passion for precision and innovation led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he worked for a local automotive manufacturer before transitioning to motorsports. For the last 15 years, he's been a valued fabricator, known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to craft bespoke components that optimize performance.

He approaches his work with a blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern techniques. István believes that the key to success lies not only in technical expertise but also in understanding the driver's needs and the vehicle's dynamics. He's renowned for his ability to diagnose problems quickly and devise creative solutions, often pushing the boundaries of what's possible. His insights into vehicle stress points are invaluable to the team.

What sets István apart is his unwavering commitment to perfection and his ability to see beyond the immediate task. He's always thinking about the long-term implications of his work, ensuring that every component he fabricates is not only functional but also durable and reliable.

physical.description: A sturdy man with a thoughtful gaze, his hands bear the marks of years spent shaping metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needlepoint before starting a task.
Insists on listening to classical music while welding.
Keeps a small notebook filled with engineering sketches and inspirational quotes.
